raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "11.0"

package:
  name: pyslang
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/MikePopoloski/slang/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 50676d5a9adbefb97d266a4b174e6b0513901afd5ac57a6cdfea0a61149c3704
  patches:
    - fmt-12.2.patch
    - cross-free-threaded-python.patch

build:
  number: 2
  script:
    - if: unix and build_platform != target_platform and "cp314t" in python
      then: CMAKE_ARGS="${CMAKE_ARGS} -DPython_FIND_ABI=OFF;OFF;OFF;ON -DPython_INCLUDE_DIR=${PREFIX}/include/python3.14t"
    - if: unix
      then: CMAKE_ARGS="${CMAKE_ARGS} -GNinja -DCMAKE_CXX_SCAN_FOR_MODULES=OFF" python -m pip install . -vv --no-build-isolation
    - if: win
      then: set "CMAKE_ARGS=%CMAKE_ARGS% -GNinja -DCMAKE_CXX_SCAN_FOR_MODULES=OFF -DSLANG_USE_MIMALLOC=OFF" && python -m pip install . -vv --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake >=3.20
    - ninja
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - scikit-build-core
    - pybind11 >=3.0
    - pybind11-stubgen
    - fmt >=12.1
    - libboost-devel
    - if: not win
      then:
        - mimalloc >=2.2
  run:
    - python
    - slang-verilog ==${{ version }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pyslang
      pip_check: true

about:
  homepage: https://sv-lang.com/
  summary: Python bindings for slang, a library for compiling SystemVerilog
  description: |
    pyslang provides Python bindings for slang, a software library that
    provides various components needed to lexically analyze, parse, type
    check, and elaborate SystemVerilog code.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/MikePopoloski/slang
  documentation: https://sv-lang.com/pyslang/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - timkpaine
